w:r.w:t: Website Build Guide — Frontend + Backend + AI/RAG
Implementation-ready specification for the development team

This document is the implementation build guide for the proposed BIS AI Intelligent Assistant website. It is intentionally written as a build specification: what to create, where it belongs, what API it calls, what data it expects, and how the frontend, backend and AI/RAG layers connect.

Core product: a single conversational interface that helps a user move from a product idea/question to applicable BIS standards, quality/testing requirements, certification guidance, laboratory options, evidence and official BIS next actions.
Source basis: the uploaded SIH Problem Statement 26107. fileciteturn0file0

User: "I want to manufacture an electric kettle. What BIS requirements must my product satisfy, which standard applies, what tests are required, which laboratory can test it, and how do I apply for certification?"
